remarks: Welcome to this charming 2. story Colonial home, offering just over 1,800 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space where pride of ownership truly shines. The main level boasts a light-filled, open floor plan with exceptional flow, complete with fresh paint and stylish luxury vinyl tile flooring throughout the entire first floor. At the heart of this level is a bright white kitchen equipped with durable Corian countertops, a dedicated pantry, and a full appliance package including a stove, refrigerator, and dishwasher. This space flows seamlessly into the formal dining area, making everyday meals and entertaining effortless. A convenient main floor laundry room and half bath complete the 1st level. Up the stairs, you will find 4 spacious bedrooms, a cozy sitting area, and a fully updated full bath. Every corner of this residence has been meticulously maintained and upgraded for modern peace of mind. Major mechanical and structural updates include a newer roof, vinyl windows, hot water tank, furnace, central AC, updated electrical, and a front-yard drainage system. Step outside to appreciate the double wide concrete driveway leading to a 1 car detached garage. The backyard serves as an inviting outdoor retreat, complete with a lovely patio designed for summer barbecues and evening relaxation. Showing start immediately on this adorable and affordable home!
